detail: Installs a portable GitHub Actions workflow, JSON limits, and a stdlib-only Python checker. PR and merge queue runs scan changed files; manual and scheduled runs scan the whole repository.

files.contents:
name: {{script_title}}

on:
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
    types: [checks_requested]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: Files to scan
        required: false
        default: all
        type: choice
        options:
          - all
          - changed
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 5 * * 1"

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-scope-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  readability:
    name: {{script_title}}
    runs-on: [{{runner_labels}}]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Select scan mode
        id: scan
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          case "${{ github.event_name }}" in
            pull_request)
              echo "mode=changed" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "base=${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "head=${{ github.sha }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              ;;
            merge_group)
              echo "mode=changed" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "base=${{ github.event.merge_group.base_sha }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "head=${{ github.sha }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              ;;
            workflow_dispatch)
              echo "mode=${{ inputs.mode }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "base=origin/${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "head=HEAD" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              ;;
            *)
              echo "mode=all" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "base=origin/${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "head=HEAD" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              ;;
          esac

      - name: Run {{script_title}}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          if [ "${{ steps.scan.outputs.mode }}" = "changed" ]; then
            python3 scripts/{{script_slug}}.py \
              --config .{{script_slug}}.json \
              --mode changed \
              --base "${{ steps.scan.outputs.base }}" \
              --head "${{ steps.scan.outputs.head }}"
          else
            python3 scripts/{{script_slug}}.py --config .{{script_slug}}.json --mode all
          fi

pullRequestBody:
Adds {{script_title}} managed by CI Scope.

This PR adds:
- `.github/workflows/{{script_slug}}.yml`
- `.{{script_slug}}.json`
- `scripts/{{script_slug}}.py`

The workflow checks changed files on pull requests and merge queue runs, and scans the full repository on manual or scheduled runs.
